z-m-14-14.title: Ukubhala kabusha imiyalelo yeribhoni yokubopha ibhokisi lesipho
z-m-14-14.topic: Ubude be-cuboid nobude beribhoni (ukubhala kabusha imiyalelo)
z-m-14-14.goal: Funda ukuthola ubude ngokulandela indlela iribhoni elihamba ngayo ngempela, futhi ubhale kabusha imiyalelo engalungile ibe elungile.
z-m-14-14.material: Ibhokisi lesipho yi-cuboid engu-20 cm ububanzi, 15 cm ubude, no-10 cm ukuphakama. Ufuna ukubopha leli bhokisi ngeribhoni ngesimo sesiphambano. Iribhoni lidlula maphakathi nobuso obungaphezulu bebhokisi ngama-engeli aqondile, lihamba liqonde phansi ezinhlangothini, futhi lidlula futhi maphakathi nobuso obungezansi. Intambo eyodwa izungeza ibhokisi kanye ngohlangothi lobubanzi futhi enye izungeza kanye ngohlangothi lobude. Ungacabangi ngobukhulu beribhoni, futhi usebenzise okwengeziwe okungu-25 cm kokuboshwa nokwenza i-bow.
z-m-14-14.prereq.0: Ububanzi, ubude, ukuphakama, nesikhundla sobuso be-cuboid (amaBanga 4-5)
z-m-14-14.s.s1.prompt: USoyoung uthole ubude beribhoni ngale ndlela. Khetha umugqa owodwa ongalungile.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.hint.0: Landelela ngomunwe wakho ukuthi iribhoni elilodwa lidlula kobuphi ubuso bebhokisi ngokulandelana.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.hint.1: Kuleso sibalo sobude, bala ukuthi ububanzi, ubude, nokuphakama ngayinye kungena izikhathi ezingaki.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.0: Cabanga ukuthi iribhoni lilandela imiphetho yebhokisi. I-cuboid inemiphetho eyi-12.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.1: Kunemiphetho eyi-4 yobubanzi, emi-4 yobude, nemi-4 yokuphakama, ngakho 4×(20+15+10)=180 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.2: Ukwengeza u-25 cm wokuboshwa ne-bow kunika 180+25=205 cm odingekayo.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.explain: Akulungile kusukela emugqeni 1. Iribhoni elibotshwe ngesimo sesiphambano alilandeli imiphetho; lidlula maphakathi nobuso obungaphezulu nobungezansi. Ngakho u-180 cm emugqeni 2 no-205 cm emugqeni 3 nabo abalungile. Uhambo olulodwa ngohlangothi lobubanzi lungu-20+10+20+10=60 cm, uhambo olulodwa ngohlangothi lobude lungu-15+10+15+10=50 cm, ngakho 60+50+25=135 cm kulungile.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.prompt: Isitolo seribhoni sinocezu olulodwa kuphela lweribhoni elingu-120 cm elisele. Yenza osayizi abathathu abahlukene beblokisi le-cuboid elingaboshwa ngalolu cezu olulodwa lweribhoni ngendlela efanayo nangenhla (isimo sesiphambano, 25 cm wokuboshwa) futhi anomthamo okungenani oyi-1500 cm³. (ububanzi a ≥ ubude b ≥ ukuphakama h, zonke izinombolo zemvelo okungenani ezingu-5, iyunithi cm)
z-m-14-14.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa indlela oyithole ngenhla, beka ububanzi, ubude, nokuphakama futhi uqale ubale ukuthi iribhoni elingakanani lidingekayo.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.hint.1: Gcina iribhoni lingedluli u-120 cm ngenkathi ushintsha ububanzi, ubude, nokuphakama, futhi uqhathanise imithamo.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c1: Kumele kube ububanzi ≥ ubude ≥ ukuphakama futhi ukuphakama kumele kube okungenani u-5.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c3: Iribhoni (uhambo olulodwa ngohlangothi lobubanzi + uhambo olulodwa ngohlangothi lobude + 25 cm wokuboshwa) lidlula u-120 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c4: Umthamo ungaphansi kuka-1500 cm³. Zama ukwenza ibhokisi libe likhulu noma ushintshe isimo salo.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.explain: Ubude beribhoni ngu-(ububanzi×2+ukuphakama×2)+(ubude×2+ukuphakama×2)+25 = ububanzi×2+ubude×2+ukuphakama×4+25. Ukuze ube ngu-120 cm noma ngaphansi, ububanzi×2+ubude×2+ukuphakama×4 kumele kube ngu-95 noma ngaphansi. Isibonelo, 15×15×8 udinga iribhoni elingu-117 cm futhi unomthamo ongu-1800 cm³. 20×12×6 udinga iribhoni elingu-113 cm kodwa umthamo wawo ungu-1440 cm³, ngakho awusebenzi.

Ukuze isetshenziswe noma usayizi webhokisi ushintsha, sho ukuthi iribhoni lidlula kuphi, ukuthi ububanzi, ubude, nokuphakama ngayinye kubalwa izikhathi ezingaki, nokuthi uphatha kanjani ubude obusetshenziselwa ukuboshwa.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala, ngokulandelana, amagama obuso iribhoni elidlula kuyo ngesikhathi sohambo olulodwa lokuzungeza.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala uhambo olulodwa ngohlangothi lobubanzi nohambo olulodwa ngohlangothi lobude njengezisho ezihlukene, bese uzihlanganisa.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Umngani ofunda le miyalelo kuphela angabala ubude beribhoni lebhokisi losayizi ohlukile nalo?
z-m-14-14.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubhale ngqo ukuthi ububanzi, ubude, nokuphakama ngayinye kubalwa izikhathi ezingaki?
z-m-14-14.s.s3.model.0: Iribhoni alilandeli imiphetho; lidlula maphakathi nobuso obungaphezulu nasemaphakathi nobuso obungezansi. Isikhathi esisodwa lidlula ububanzi bobuso obungaphezulu, ukuphakama kobuso lohlangothi, ububanzi bobuso obungezansi, nokuphakama kobuso lohlangothi oluphambene, ngakho kungu-(ububanzi×2+ukuphakama×2). Esinye isikhathi kungu-(ubude×2+ukuphakama×2). Engeza izikhathi ezimbili futhi wengeze ubude bokuboshwa. Kulelibhokisi kungu-60+50+25=135 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.model.1: Iribhoni lidlula ngesimo sesiphambano maphakathi nobuso obungaphezulu nobungezansi bebhokisi, hhayi ngemiphetho. Bese wengeza ubude bokuboshwa.

z-m-14-11.title: Ubheka kusuka phezulu iyisiyingi. Ingaba yisiphi isimo?
z-m-14-11.topic: Ama-cylinder, ama-cone, nama-sphere: izimo zawo kuye ngesiqondiso obuka kuso
z-m-14-11.goal: Qonda ukuthi isimo esibonwa ohlangothini olulodwa singase singanquli into eqinile, khetha ulwazi oludingekayo ukunquma isimo njengesisodwa, bese wenza umbuzo ohlukanisa lezi zimo.
z-m-14-11.material: Isimo esiqinile sisetafuleni. Lesi simo siyisisodwa se-cylinder, i-cone, noma i-sphere. I-cylinder ne-cone zimiswe mpo nesisekelo saso esiyindingilizi phansi (isihloko esibukhali se-cone siphezulu), futhi i-sphere ilala nje lapho. Umngani ubheke phansi ngqo kusuka phezulu wathi, "Ngibona isiyingi!"
z-m-14-11.thinking.1: Ukuthola isibonelo esiphikisayo (isimo esihlukile esibukeka ngendlela efanayo)
z-m-14-11.prereq.1: Ukucabanga ngezimo eziqinile ezibonwa kusuka phezulu, phambili nasohlangothini
z-m-14-11.s.s1.prompt: Ungasho ukuthi siyisiphi isimo ngesitatimende kuphela sokuthi isimo esibonwa kusuka phezulu siyisiyingi?
z-m-14-11.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga bese udweba isimo sesimo ngasinye kwezintathu eziqinile esibonwa kusuka phezulu.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.hint.1: Hlanganisa izimo ezibukeka zifana kusuka phezulu.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.o.a: Iyi-cylinder. Uma isimo esibonwa kusuka phezulu siyisiyingi, iyi-cylinder.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuthi i-cone noma i-sphere ibukeka kanjani kusuka phezulu.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.o.b: Ibukeka njengesiyingi noma iyi-cylinder, i-cone, noma i-sphere.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange futhi waqhathanisa isimo sesinye kwezintathu esibonwa kusuka phezulu.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.o.c: Iyi-sphere. Isimo kuphela esibukeka njengesiyingi yi-sphere.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.r.c: Kusuka eqinisweni lokuthi i-sphere ibukeka njengesiyingi kusuka kuwo wonke amacala, usho ngokuphambene ukuthi uma ibukeka njengesiyingi, iyi-sphere.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.o.d: Iyi-cone. Uma isihloko esibukhali siphezulu, isimo esibonwa kusuka phezulu siyisiyingi.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.r.d: Awuhlolanga izimo ze-cylinder ne-sphere ezibonwa kusuka phezulu.
z-m-14-11.s.s1.explain: I-cylinder emiswe mpo ibonwa kusuka phezulu ibonisa isiyingi sobuso bayo obuphezulu, i-cone enesihloko saso siphezulu ibonisa isiyingi sesisekelo sayo, futhi i-sphere ibonisa isiyingi. Ngakho awukwazi ukuhlukanisa izimo ezintathu ngesimo esibonwa kusuka phezulu kuphela.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.prompt: Ngaphezu kweqiniso lokuthi isimo esibonwa kusuka phezulu siyisiyingi, ukwazi yimuphi walolu lwazi olulandelayo olwenza isimo sinqunywe njengesisodwa? Khetha konke okufanelayo.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi isimo esibonwa kusuka phambili sihluka kanjani kwesinye ngasinye kwezintathu.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.hint.1: Bala, eyodwa ngesikhathi, ukuthi mangaki izimo ezanelisa ulwazi ngalunye.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.r.a: Ukhethe ngokusebenza ukuthi isimo esisodwa kuphela sinonxande njengombono wasemuva.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.o.b: Ububanzi besiyingi esibonwa kusuka phezulu bungu-6 cm.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.r.b: Ungenza i-cylinder, i-cone ne-sphere zonke zibe nosayizi ofanayo. Usayizi awukwazi ukuhlukanisa izinhlobo zezimo.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.r.c: Ukhethe ngokusebenza ukuthi isimo esisodwa kuphela sinonxantathu njengombono wasemuva.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.r.d: Ungenza i-cylinder ne-cone ngokuphakama okufanayo, futhi i-sphere enobubanzi obungu-6 cm nayo inokuphakama okungu-6 cm. Ukuphakama akukwazi ukunquma isimo.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.r.e: Ukhethe ngokusebenza ukuthi isimo esisodwa kuphela sinesiyingi njengombono wasemuva.
z-m-14-11.s.s2.explain: Uma umbono wasemuva ununxande iyi-cylinder, uma ununxantathu iyi-cone, futhi uma uyisiyingi iyi-sphere. Usayizi (ububanzi) noma ukuphakama kungenziwa kufane kuzo zonke izimo ezintathu, ngakho akunqumi isimo.
z-m-14-11.s.s3.prompt: Ufuna ukunika umngani umbuzo. Yenza umbuzo owodwa ohlukanisa lezi zimo ezintathu eziyizindingilizi kusuka phezulu, bese ubhala ukuthi impendulo iphuma kanjani esimeni ngasinye.
z-m-14-11.s.s3.hint.0: Qala udweba isimo se-cylinder esibonwa kusuka phambili.
z-m-14-11.s.s3.hint.1: Thola isiqondiso lapho izimpendulo zezimo ezintathu zihluka khona.

z-m-14-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe impendulo yombuzo wami iphuma ihlukile ezimweni ezintathu zonke?
z-m-14-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umbuzo ngombono wasemuva nombuzo ngombono wasohlangothini unikeza umphumela ofanayo?
z-m-14-11.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange futhi ukuthi isimo esibonwa kusuka phezulu singasetshenziswa njengombuzo?
z-m-14-11.s.s3.model.0: Ngizobuza ukuthi isimo esibonwa kusuka phambili siyini. I-cylinder izophendula unxande, i-cone unxantathu, ne-sphere isiyingi.
z-m-14-11.s.s3.model.1: Ngizobuza ngesimo esibonwa kusuka ohlangothini. I-sphere iyisiyingi, i-cylinder inunxande (noma isikwele), ne-cone inunxantathu, ngakho zingahlukaniswa ngasikhathi sinye.
z-m-14-11.s.s3.modelNote.1: Usho ukuthi umphumela uyafana noma isiqondiso singohlangothi.

z-m-14-01.title: Uhamba ngo-60 km ngehora futhi ubuye ngo-40 km ngehora: isilinganiso sohambo lokuya nokubuya siyini?
z-m-14-01.topic: Isivinini esimaphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya: uma amabanga efana nalapho izikhathi zifana
z-m-14-01.goal: Hlola ngezibonelo zezinombolo umcabango wokulinganisela isivinini esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya njengo-"maphakathi nezivinini ezimbili," futhi usho ukuthi umphumela uhluka kanjani uma ugcina ibanga lifana nalapho ugcina isikhathi sifana.
z-m-14-01.material: Umndeni kaMina uye futhi wabuya kogogo ngemoto emgwaqweni ofanayo. Endleleni yokuya bagibela ngesivinini esingu-60 km ngehora (isivinini sokuhamba u-60 km ehoreni elilodwa) kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, futhi endleleni yokubuya bagibela ngesivinini esingu-40 km ngehora kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, ngaphandle kokuphumula phakathi. Ibanga lendlela yokuya nelendlela yokubuya liyafana. Lapha, "isivinini esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya" yisivinini ngehora obungaba naso uma ubuqhuba lonke umgwaqo ukuya nokubuya ngesivinini esifanayo njalo. Awukazi okwamanje ukuthi ibanga lingu-km bangaki.

z-m-14-01.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza isahlulelo sakho nokuzethemba ngemva kokubona ulwazi olusha
z-m-14-01.thinking.2: Ukushintsha ibanga ukuze ubone ukuthi umphumela uyashintsha yini
z-m-14-01.thinking.3: Ukuthola umbandela lapho umphumela uncike kulokho okugcinwe kufana khona

z-m-14-01.prereq.1: Ukushintsha amayunithi ezikhathi (ihora elingu-1 nemizuzu engu-30 lingamahora angu-1.5)
z-m-14-01.s.s1.prompt: Njalo uma kwengezwa ucezu lolwazi, khetha umcabango wakho ngesivinini esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya. Awudingi ukushintsha umcabango wakho wokuqala. Hlulela wena ukuthi ubufakazi bwanele yini.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha ibanga futhi uqale uthole ukuthi ihora ngalinye lithatha amahora amangaki endleleni yokuya nendleleni yokubuya.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funda ulwazi olusha futhi uqhathanise eyodwa ngeyodwa lapho lufana khona nalapho luhlukile khona nomcabango owawukhethile ekuqaleni.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Indlela yokuya ingu-60 km ngehora futhi indlela yokubuya ingu-40 km ngehora. Awukazi okwamanje ibanga lohlangothi olulodwa noma isikhathi esithathiwe.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ubheka lolu lwazi kuphela, ucabanga ukuthi isivinini esiphakathi sohambo lokuya nokubuya singakanani?
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Akukho uhlangothi oluqinisekisiwe okwamanje. Ukukhetha ibanga futhi ubale ngqo kuzosiza isahlulelo sakho.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Singu-50 km ngehora ngqo. Lokhu ngoba singaphakathi kuka-60 no-40.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lo ngumcabango othatha inani eliphakathi lezivinini ezimbili njengesilinganiso. Ungahlola kamuva ukuthi lo mcabango ubamba nini.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubonakala kuzoba ngaphansi kuka-50 km ngehora. Lokhu ngoba isikhathi esichithwe ngesivinini esiphansi sibonakala side.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucabange hhayi nje ngezivinini kodwa nangobude besikhathi esichithwe ngesivinini ngasinye.
z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kubonakala kuzoba ngaphezulu kuka-50 km ngehora. Lokhu ngoba bagibele ngokushesha endleleni yokuya.

z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Singu-52 km ngehora. Bashesha endleleni yokuya, ngakho sikhulu kuno-50.

z-m-14-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuwo wonke amabanga amathathu ahloliwe, kungu-48 km ngehora. Kodwa-ke, lokhu akunquli amabanga angahloliwe.

z-m-14-02.title: Ukukhulisa isithombe ukuze sifanele uhlaka ngqo
z-m-14-02.topic: Ukwenza isikhathi side ngomlinganiselo ofanayo nemibandela yebanga
z-m-14-02.goal: Uma ukhulisa ububanzi nobude besithombe ngomlinganiselo ofanayo, yenza osayizi abaningana abangenzeka phakathi komandela wosayizi wohlaka, futhi uthole omkhulu kakhulu ongangena.
z-m-14-02.material: UDoyun ufuna ukuprinta isithombe esingu-12 cm ububanzi no-9 cm ubude sibe sikhulu futhi asibeke ohlakeni. Ukuze agcine isithombe singagobisiwe, kumele akhulise ububanzi nobude ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Usayizi wangaphakathi wohlaka lapho isithombe siya khona ungu-30 cm ububanzi no-21 cm ubude. Lonke isithombe kumele singene ngaphakathi kosayizi wangaphakathi (ububanzi obungaphezu kuka-30 cm, ubude obungaphezu kuka-21 cm), futhi isithombe kumele sibe sikhulu kunalokho esiyikona manje. Bhala ubude nge-cm, futhi indawo eyodwa yedesimali iyavunyelwa.
z-m-14-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza isixazululo esanelisa imibandela eminingana (umlinganiselo nebanga) ngasikhathi sinye
z-m-14-02.thinking.2: Ukuqaphela ukuthi ukufanisa uhlangothi olulodwa kungenza olunye lufinyelele ngaphandle

z-m-14-04.title: Epaki yokungcebeleka, mangaki ama-ride enza i-pass ibe nenzuzo?
z-m-14-04.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela ezimbili zokukhokha ezishintsha ngenani lama-ride, usebenzisa itafula nesisho, uthole ukuthi eshibhe kakhulu incike enanini lama-ride nokuthi umngcele ukuphi, futhi uhlanganise njengesincomo.
z-m-14-04.material: Umndeni kaMinseo ukhetha eyodwa yezindlela ezimbili epaki yokungcebeleka. Endleleni A, uthenga i-pass engenamkhawulo ngo-20000원, futhi awukhokhi okunye noma ugibela ama-ride amangaki. Endleleni B, uthenga ithikithi lokungena ngo-8000원 futhi ukhokha u-1500원 njalo uma ugibela i-ride. UMinseo uhlela ukugibela ama-ride angu-n ngosuku olulodwa, futhi angagibela ngaphezu kuka-20 ama-ride ngosuku. Ayikho enye imali edingekayo ngaphandle kwentengo yethikithi, futhi ama-ride abalwa esisodwa ngesisodwa.

z-m-14-05.title: Ukuhlanganisa amasikwele angu-10 ezinduku zamashisi
z-m-14-05.topic: Ukuthola umthetho nokuwubhala njengesisho (amasikwele ezinduku zamashisi)
z-m-14-05.goal: Thola umthetho phakathi kwenani lamasikwele ahlanganisiwe nenani lezinduku zamashisi, uhlulele ukuthi izisho ezibhalwe ngezimo ezihlukile zibonisa umthetho ofanayo yini, bese uthola futhi ulungise iphutha endleleni umthetho obalwe ngayo.
z-m-14-05.material: Yenza imimumo ngokuhlanganisa amasikwele emgqeni ngezinduku zamashisi. Udinga izinduku zamashisi ezingu-4 ukwenza isikwele esingu-1, ezingu-7 ukuhlanganisa amasikwele angu-2, nezingu-10 ukuhlanganisa amasikwele angu-3. Lapho amasikwele ethinta uma ehlanganisiwe, abelana induku eyodwa yeshisi. Awuyephuli izinduku zamashisi noma uzilale phezu komunye.
z-m-14-05.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ukuthi izisho ezihlukile zibonisa umthetho ofanayo yini
z-m-14-05.prereq.0: Ukuthola inombolo emumweni olandelayo wephethini enomthetho (Ibanga 5)
z-m-14-05.prereq.1: Ukusebenzisa u-□ ukubonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinombolo (Ibanga 5-6)
z-m-14-05.s.s1.prompt: USeoyun wathola inani lezinduku zamashisi ezidingekayo ukuhlanganisa amasikwele angu-10 njengoba kubonisiwe ngezansi. Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bala icala lamasikwele angu-2 ngesisho esifanayo bese uhlola ukuthi liyafana yini no-7 wangempela.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi wenza kangaki u-"engeza elilodwa elengeziwe" ukusuka kusikwele esingu-1 kuya kumasikwele angu-10.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.line.0: Udinga izinduku zamashisi ezingu-4 ngesikwele esingu-1, ezingu-7 ngamasikwele angu-2, nezingu-10 ngamasikwele angu-3.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.line.1: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho inani lamasikwele likhuphuka ngelilodwa, izinduku zamashisi zikhuphuka ngo-3.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.line.2: Bese ngamasikwele angu-10, ikhuphuka ngo-3, izikhathi ezingu-10, kusukela ku-4 wokuqala, ngakho 4+3×10=34.
z-m-14-05.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphosile. U-4 wokuqala usevele uyinani lesikwele esingu-1, ngakho ukuze ufinyelele kumasikwele angu-10, inani lokwenyuka ngu-9, hhayi u-10. U-4+3×9=31 ulungile, futhi u-34 emgqeni wokugcina uphosile njengomphumela.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke izisho ezibonisa ngendlela efanele inani lezinduku zamashisi ezidingekayo uma kunamasikwele angu-□. (Indlela yokufunda: × ukuphindaphinda, − ukukhipha)
z-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-1, 2 no-3 esikhundleni sika-□ kusisho ngasinye bese uhlola ukuthi silingana yini nezinombolo zangempela ezingu-4, 7 no-10.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.1: Noma izisho zibukeka zihlukile, bheka ukuthi ezinye zinika inombolo efanayo ngokufaka inombolo efanayo esikhundleni sika-□ bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.a: Lesi isisho esibale izinhlangothi ezithintanayo kanye ngaphezulu. Uma u-□ engu-2, sinika u-8, ohlukile ku-7 wangempela.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kubonisa umthetho wokwenyuka ngo-3 isikhathi ngasinye nowokuqala o-1 ngokuhlukile.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.c: Uthathe izinhlangothi ezigqagqanayo njengo-□. Bala ukuthi zingaki izindawo ezithintanayo uma amasikwele angu-□ ehlanganisiwe.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.d: Ubale zonke izinhlangothi zesikwele ngasinye bese ukhipha inani lezindawo ezithintanayo.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.e: Lesi isisho esifanela inani elilodwa noma amabili kuphela. Siphinde usihlole ngamasikwele angu-2 nangu-3.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.r.f: Usibonise ngokwenza isikwele sokuqala sibe ngu-1 kuqala bese wengeza u-3 kwabasele ngamunye.
z-m-14-05.s.s2.explain: Isikwele esingu-1 sithatha izinduku zamashisi ezingu-4, futhi isikhathi ngasinye lapho uhlanganisa esisodwa, sikhuphuka ngo-3. Ngakho 4+3×(□−1), 4×□−(□−1), no-3×□+1 konke kungumthetho ofanayo. Ungahlola ngokufaka amasikwele angu-1, 2 no-3 ukubona ukuthi uthola u-4, 7 no-10 yini.
z-m-14-05.s.s3.prompt: Zidingeka izinduku zamashisi ezingaki ukuhlanganisa amasikwele angu-10? Chaza izindlela ezimbili ezihlukile zokuhlola ukuthi impendulo yakho ilungile.
z-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokuhlola ngezinombolo ezincane (amasikwele angu-2 nangu-3).
z-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi ikhuphuka ngamangaki isikhathi ngasinye lapho kwengezwa elilodwa, nokuthi zingaki izindawo ezithintanayo.
z-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uhlole ukuthi isisho sakho silungile ngezinombolo ezincane (amasikwele angu-2 nangu-3) nakho?
z-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Uhlukanise ukuthi impendulo engu-31 iyinani olibalile ngempela noma iyinani elivela esishweni?
z-m-14-05.s.s3.model.0: Ingu-31. Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kwengezwa isikwele, ikhuphuka ngo-3, ngakho ukwengeza u-3 izikhathi eziyisishiyagalolunye ku-4 wokuqala kunika u-4+27=31. Futhi, kusuka ku-4×10=40, ukukhipha izinhlangothi ezingu-9 ezithintanayo futhi ezabelwanayo nakho kunika u-31.
z-m-14-05.s.s3.model.1: 31. 3×10+1=31. Ukubala ngokuqala ngokubeka uhlangothi olu-1 oluqondile bese wengeza u-3 ngesikwele ngasinye ngomumo webakaki nakho kunika u-31. Kuqinisekiswa nangokukhipha izinhlangothi ezigqagqanayo: 4×10−9=31.

z-m-14-10.title: Uma unamathelisa amabhokisi amabili ndawonye, kwenzekani endaweni yobuso bangaphandle?
z-m-14-10.topic: Indawo yobuso bangaphandle yesimo esenziwe ngokuhlanganisa imiumo
z-m-14-10.goal: Thola iphutha esixazululweni esithi "engeza nje izindawo zobuso bangaphandle zayo ngayinye" lapho uthola indawo yobuso bangaphandle yesimo esenziwe ngokuhlanganisa amabhokisi amabili anezinhlangothi eziyisithupha, bese uhlulela umbandela lapho indawo yokuhlanganisa ithinta indawo yobuso bangaphandle.
z-m-14-10.material: Beka ibhokisi elincane B (4 cm ububanzi, 6 cm ubude, 3 cm ukuphakama) ebusweni obuphezulu bebhokisi elikhulu A (10 cm ububanzi, 6 cm ubude, 4 cm ukuphakama) bese uwanamathelisa ukwenza isimo esisodwa. Wonke ingaphansi lika-B (4 cm ububanzi, 6 cm ubude) lithinta ubuso obuphezulu buka-A, futhi ubude buka-B obungu-6 cm bufana nobude buka-A obungu-6 cm, ngakho ubuso bangaphambili nobangemuva buqondaniswe. Ufuna ukupenda wonke ubuso obubonakala ngaphandle kwalesi simo (kufaka nobuso obungaphansi). "Indawo yobuso bangaphandle" yisamba sezindawo zobuso bonke obubonakala ngaphandle.
z-m-14-10.thinking.1: Ukuhlulela ukuthi indlela (indawo) yokuhlanganisa ishintsha umphumela yini
z-m-14-10.thinking.2: Ukucabanga ukuthi isiphetho sishintsha kanjani uma imibandela ishintsha
z-m-14-10.prereq.0: Ukuthola indawo yobuso bangaphandle yebhokisi elinezinhlangothi eziyisithupha (ibanga 5)
z-m-14-10.s.s1.prompt: USeohyeon uthole indawo yobuso bangaphandle kanje. Khetha umugqa owodwa ongalungile.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.0: Thola ukuthi yiziphi izindawo ezingasabonakali ngaphandle uma u-A no-B behlanganisiwe.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi indawo yobuso obungabonakali ifakiwe ku-248 nakokungu-108 ngamunye yini.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.line.2: Indawo yobuso bangaphandle yesimo esihlanganisiwe izindawo zobuso bangaphandle buka-A no-B ezengeziwe: 248+108=356 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho indawo okufanele ipendwe ngu-356 cm².

z-m-14-08.topic: Ikhubhu elenziwe ngezigaxa zeyunithi nenani lobuso obupendiwe

z-m-14-09.title: Ukulinganisela indawo yesiyingi ngegridi
z-m-14-09.goal: Usebenzisa izikwele isiyingi esizifaka ngokuphelele egridini nezikwele esizimboza ngokwengxenye, sho izinga lapho indawo yesiyingi iphakathi khona, bese uhlola ukulinganisela kwakho ngokubona ukuthi izinga lishintsha kanjani uma izikwele zenziwa zibe zincane.
z-m-14-09.material: Isiyingi esinoradiyasi engu-5 cm sidwetshwe ephepheni legridi lapho isikwele ngasinye sibanzi u-1 cm futhi side u-1 cm (indawo u-1 cm²). Isikhungo sesiyingi sisepoyinti elilodwa legridi. Kunezikwele ezingu-60 ngaphakathi ngokuphelele kwesiyingi, futhi kufakwe nezikwele umugqa wesiyingi odlula kuzo, kunezikwele ezingu-88 sekukonke ezingaphakathi okungenani ngokwengxenye. Cabanga ukuthi awukayifundi indlela yokuthola indawo yesiyingi.
z-m-14-09.prereq.0: Incazelo yendawo nokubala izikwele zegridi ze-1 cm² (ibanga 3-4)

z-m-14-09.s.s1.explain: Isiyingi sikhulu kunezikwele ezingu-60 ezingaphakathi ngokuphelele, futhi sincane kunezikwele ezingu-88 ezingaphakathi okungenani ngokwengxenye. Ngakho singasho ukuthi sikhulu kuno-60 cm² futhi sincane kuno-88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala amanani amathathu ahlukile (ku-cm²) ocabanga ukuthi ayilokuhlolwa okufanelekile kwendawo yalesi siyingi. (Wabhale njengezinombolo ezigcwele.)

z-m-14-12.title: Ubude bentambo ebopha amakani amathathu
z-m-14-12.topic: Ubude bomjikelezo usebenzisa umjikelezo wesiyingi (ukubopha amakani)
z-m-14-12.goal: Linganisela ubude bentambo ezungeza ithinta amakani ngokuyihlukanisa ibe izingxenye eziqondile nezingxenye eziyindingilizi, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ubude bentambo bushintsha kanjani kuye ngokuhlelwa.
z-m-14-12.material: Misa amakani angu-3 ase-cylinder anobubanzi obungu-6 cm bese uwabopha ngentambo eyodwa edonswe kanzima kanye ezungeze maphakathi nokuphakama kwamakani. Intambo ithinta izindlu zamakani ngaphandle kwezikhala, futhi ungacabangi ngentambo esetshenziselwe indawo ebophiwe. Bala i-pi njengo-3.14. Kunezindlela ezimbili zokubeka amakani. (가) Misa amakani amathathu eceleni komunye emgqeni, ethintana. (나) Misa amakani amathathu ngesimo sikanxantathu ukuze athintane wonke.
z-m-14-12.thinking.0: Ukucabanga ngomjikelezo wesimo ngokuwuhlukanisa abe izingxenye
z-m-14-12.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kobubanzi nobubanzi obuhhafu besiyingi
z-m-14-12.s.s1.prompt: Ngaphambi kokubala ubude bentambo edingekayo uma ubopha nge-(가) nge-(나), linganisela kuqala. Iyiphi ebonakala ide kakhulu?
z-m-14-12.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba izindingilizi ezintathu ezibonwa kusuka phezulu bese udweba umugqa ngendlela intambo edlula ngayo.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.hint.1: Phawula amaphoyinti lapho intambo isuka engxenyeni eyindingilizi iye engxenyeni eqondile bese ubala ukuthi zingaki izingxenye eziqondile.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.a: I-(나) ide kakhulu. Igoba ezinhlangothini ezintathu, ngakho intambo idlula ezingxenyeni eziyindingilizi eziningi.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi ukugoba okuningi kwenza ibe ende. Isebenzele ngokwengeza ubude lapho intambo idlula ezingxenyeni eziyindingilizi.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.b: Izindlela ezimbili ziyafana. Noma ngayiphi indlela, ihlanganisa wonke amakani angu-3.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.b: Weqe ukuthi intambo ayizungezi wonke amakani; phakathi kwamakani athintanayo, iya ngqo ngaphandle kokulandela umphetho.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.c: I-(가) ide kakhulu. Ingxenye eya ngqo phakathi kwamakani ide kakhulu ku-(가).
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.c: Uhlukanise intambo ibe izingxenye eziyindingilizi neziqondile futhi waqhathanisa izingxenye eziqondile zokuhlelwa okubili.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.d: Asikwazi ukuqhathanisa kuze kwaziwe ukuphakama kwamakani.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.d: Ubude bohambo olulodwa lwentambo bunqunywa ukuhlelwa okubonwa kusuka phezulu. Cabanga ukuthi ukuphakama kushintsha ubude bentambo yini.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.explain: Intambo ingahlukaniswa ibe izingxenye eziyindingilizi zamakani nezingxenye eziqondile phakathi kwamakani. Kuzo zombili izindlela zokuhlela, izingxenye eziyindingilizi ndawonye zenza umjikelezo wekani elilodwa, futhi ingxenye eqondile ide ku-(가). Ngakho i-(가) ibonakala ide. Ungahlola leli linganiso ngokubala.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.prompt: U-Hansol uthole ubude bentambo yokubopha nge-(가) njengoba kungezansi. Khetha umugqa owodwa ongalungile.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngomugqa oxhuma izikhungo zamakani ezimbili ekugcineni bese ubala ukuthi mubi ububanzi obungakanani.

z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.0: Izindawo intambo ethinta kuzo zingahlukaniswa zibe izingxenye eziyindingilizi zamakani ezimbili ekugcineni nezingxenye eziqondile ephezulu naphansi.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.1: Ukuhlanganisa izingxenye eziyindingilizi zamakani ezimbili ekugcineni kunikeza umjikelezo wekani elilodwa, 6×3.14=18.84 cm.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.2: Ingxenye eqondile ephezulu inamakani angu-3 eceleni komunye, ngakho ubude bayo bungu-6 cm. Engezansi ingu-6 cm nayo.

z-m-14-12.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi uthola simo sini uma uxhuma izikhungo zamakani amathathu ku-(나) nokuthi uhlangothi olulodwa lude kangakanani.
z-m-14-12.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala isamba sezingxenye eziqondile nesamba sezingxenye eziyindingilizi ngokwehlukana bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-14-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ku-(나), ingabe ubhale ukuthi zingaki izingxenye eziqondile nokuthi ngayinye mingaki ama-cm?

z-m-14-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uqhathanise ukuthi isilinganiso sakho sokuqala (isinyathelo 1) nomphumela obaliwe siyafana yini?
